footer.tagline: A hotel in Dubai. Considered rooms. Open now.

home.heroBody: A hotel in Dubai where the design is quiet, the service has no script, and the only thing competing for your attention is the view.

about.label: About Cove
about.title: 106 rooms.
about.kicker: In the quieter part of a city that rarely slows down.
about.body1: One hundred and six rooms. Three dining spaces. A spa, a salon, a fitness floor — and a kitchen that earns its place at the centre of it all. Cove is not a large hotel made to feel intimate. It was always meant to be this size.
about.body2: Dubai is outside. Inside, time moves differently.

facilities.label: The building
facilities.title: More than
facilities.intro: A pool, a fitness floor, and the spaces you pass through to reach them. The parts of a hotel nobody photographs, done properly.

items.poolBody: Water, shade, and loungers set back from it.
items.gymBody: Full-height glass, and enough room to use it properly.
items.entranceBody: Off the street and out of the heat in one movement.
items.liftLobbyBody: Marble and bronze, on every floor.

band.quote: The menu changes. The standard doesn't.

items.desertBody: Into the dunes at dusk. Private driver, no fixed itinerary. A fire where the road ends and the sky gets very large.
items.cityBody: Our concierge knows which parts of the city most visitors never find. Ask them. They will tell you.
items.carBody: A car, a driver who knows the city, no need to explain where you want to go twice. By the hour or the day.

items.oneQuote: The kind of hotel that makes you reconsider how little you actually need.
items.twoQuote: In a city of tall gestures, Cove is a quiet sentence. It lands harder.
items.threeQuote: In a city built for arrival, Cove is designed for the stay itself.

items.oneQuote: I’ve stayed in many places that try too hard. Cove doesn’t try at all — it just gets things right, consistently and quietly.
items.twoQuote: The light in my room at 7 in the morning. I kept thinking about it for weeks after I left. I’m going back in March.
items.threeQuote: Breakfast alone is worth the stay. Someone asked how I wanted my eggs and then made them exactly that way.

rooms.label: Accommodation
rooms.title: Rooms &
rooms.intro: One hundred and six rooms. Each one different. All of them considered in the same way — around light, proportion, and how a room makes you feel when you walk into it.

help.title: Not sure which room is
help.body: Our team will help you choose. No obligation, no script.

dining.label: Dining
dining.title: The menu changes.
dining.intro: Open kitchen. A chef with a clear point of view. Breakfast through dinner, seven days.

loom.name: The Loom
loom.title: A kitchen that
loom.body1: Chef Suliman's menu is written around what arrives that week. It changes constantly. The care behind it does not. The space is open, the kitchen is visible, and the food is the point.
loom.body2: Breakfast is unhurried. Lunch is honest. Dinner is worth staying in for.

atelier.name: The Atelier
atelier.title: No occasion
atelier.body1: Single origin coffee in the morning. Natural wine from six. A bar that does not rush you and a room that does not try too hard. The Atelier is for guests and non-guests alike.
atelier.body2: Come for an hour. Stay longer. Nobody is counting.

chef.name: Amara Suliman
chef.quote: I am not trying to surprise you. I am trying to feed you very well.

private.label: Private & special
private.title: The table is
private.name: Chef's Table
private.body: Six seats. No printed menu. What arrives is what was best that morning. Selected evenings only.

wellness.label: Wellness
wellness.title: Time kept
wellness.intro: A pool deck in the open air and a fitness floor behind full-height glass, both for every guest.

pool.name: The Pool
pool.title: Shade, water,
pool.body1: Loungers under scalloped parasols, a main pool with a plunge pool beside it, and a bar within reach.
pool.body2: Come for a swim. Stay for the afternoon.

gym.name: The Fitness Floor
gym.title: Room to
gym.body1: Cardio machines facing the glass, free weights, and a studio corner with space to stretch.
gym.body2: Early or late, it is there when you are.

experiences.label: Experiences
experiences.title: Dubai,
experiences.intro: The desert is an hour from the hotel. Our concierge arranges the day for you.

safari.name: Desert Safari
safari.title: Dunes, dust
safari.body1: Quad biking across the dunes outside the city, led by experienced guides.
safari.body2: Our concierge arranges it for you — tell us the day and how many of you are going.
safari.alt: A rider on a quad bike sending up a spray of sand in the desert

about.label: About Cove
about.title: A hotel built around one
about.intro: The story behind the address, the people who made it, and the thinking that runs through every room, every material, every detail.

story.label: The story
story.title: Why Cove
story.body1: Dubai has no shortage of hotels. What it had fewer of was a place built around restraint — where the decision to do less was made deliberately, and where the resulting space allowed guests to simply be present without effort.
story.body2: Cove was conceived not as a reaction to anything, but as a position. One hundred and six rooms, chosen for quality rather than quantity. A kitchen guided by season rather than spectacle. Interiors where the materials were selected for how they age, not how they photograph.
story.body3: The hotel sits in Al Rigga — a part of Dubai that holds its own character. That, too, was a choice.

band.quote: We were not interested in building something impressive. We were interested in building something right.

items.founderBody: The vision behind Cove. Spent years in hospitality across the Middle East before deciding to build something on entirely different terms.
items.designBody: Led the interior architecture of Cove from the first sketch to the final material selection. Every surface carries a decision, and she made most of them.
items.chefBody: Three continents, two Michelin-recommended kitchens, one clear point of view. Chef Suliman's menu changes constantly. His standards do not.

philosophy.label: The philosophy
philosophy.title: How every decision
philosophy.intro: There is no single rule behind Cove except this: nothing here arrived without being considered. Not the thread count of the linen. Not the distance between the bed and the window. Not the hour the kitchen closes.

items.materialsBody: Natural stone, hand-loomed textiles, timber that ages visibly. Nothing that hides what it is.
items.scaleBody: One hundred and six rooms. The decision to stay this size was made first, not last.
items.serviceBody: No script. Staff are hired for judgement, not compliance.
items.kitchenBody: The menu follows the season. The standard never changes.
items.lightBody: Every room was positioned around how light moves through it across the day.

building.label: The building
building.title: Location &
building.body1: Cove is located in Al Rigga, Deira — one of Dubai's most established and characterful neighbourhoods, close to the Creek, minutes from the city's original pulse. The building was designed by Al Hilal architects, with interiors developed around a single brief: nothing decorative, everything considered.
building.body2: The lobby does not announce itself. There is no atrium, no moment of spectacle. There is instead a desk, a chair, and someone who knows your name.

Tick “Show on the offers page” to advertise a plan as an offer. Bookings already made keep the price they were quoted.
